summary_en: This study tests cemacabtagene ansegedleucel (cema-cel), an allogeneic CD19 CAR T cell therapy, as consolidation for adults with large B-cell lymphoma who have minimal residual disease after first-line therapy. Participants who are randomized to treatment receive cema-cel after a lymphodepletion regimen of fludarabine and cyclophosphamide; the dose schedule and treatment duration are not stated. The study assesses efficacy and safety compared with observation, and the primary outcome is not stated; it is a Phase 2 trial.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa cemacabtagene ansegedleucel (cema-cel), una terapia con células CAR T alogénicas dirigidas a CD19, como consolidación en adultos con linfoma de células B grandes que tienen enfermedad residual mínima después de la primera línea de tratamiento. Los participantes asignados al tratamiento reciben cema-cel después de un régimen de linfodepleción con fludarabina y ciclofosfamida; el esquema de dosis y la duración del tratamiento no se indican. El estudio evalúa la eficacia y la seguridad en comparación con la observación, el resultado principal no se indica, y es un ensayo de Fase 2.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with large B-cell lymphoma confirmed by pathology.
Completed standard first-line therapy with complete response, or partial response suitable for observation, on PET/CT.
Positive minimal residual disease result on the Foresight CLARITY test.
Adequate blood, kidney, liver, lung, and heart function.
not_for: Central nervous system involvement, transformed lymphoma, or T-cell/histiocyte rich large B-cell lymphoma.
Prior treatment with anti-CD19 targeted therapy.
Anti-cancer treatment, including radiation, after end-of-treatment PET/CT or MRD testing.
Active clinically significant autoimmune disease, or active systemic infection requiring systemic treatment.
Another primary malignancy or bone marrow disorder within 3 years before enrollment.
